name: Radu Popescu
bio:
Radu's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with his grandfather's Lada. What started as simple maintenance quickly evolved into a passion for understanding the intricacies of vehicle dynamics. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle performance. His professional career started at a small tuning shop, where he learned the importance of precision and attention to detail. 

Moving into test driving coordination, Radu leverages his technical knowledge to effectively manage test drivers, ensuring they provide relevant and insightful feedback. He believes in creating a collaborative environment where drivers feel comfortable communicating their observations. Radu is known for his methodical approach to problem-solving and his ability to quickly identify areas for improvement, ensuring optimal performance on the track. His loyalty to Dick Johnson Racing is unquestioned, and he always puts the team first.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Radu is of average height with a wiry build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a lucky wrench that he uses for critical adjustments.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
